english.title: Cause unlicensed person to carry on s.2(3) activity at a controlled place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON CAUSED..) to carry on the

(A)_[use of a controlled place for the unloading of gas to an installation, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTALLATION..),]_
(B)_[use of a controlled place for the unloading of gas to a pipeline]_
(C)_[use of a controlled place for the storage of gas]__
(D)_[conversion of a natural feature, namely **(..SPECIFY FEATURE..), in a controlled place for the purpose of storing gas]_
(E)_[recovery of gas stored in a controlled place]_
(F)_[exploration of a controlled place with a view to, or in connection with, the carrying on of an activity within section 2(3) of the Energy Act 2008, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..),]_
(G)_[establishment or maintenance in a controlled place of an installation for the purposes of an activity within section 2(3) of the Energy Act 2008, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..),]_

when, at the time the activity was carried on,

(H)_[he did not have]_
(I)_[she did not have]_
(J)_[he was carrying on the activity on behalf of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person who did not have]_
(K)_[she was carrying on the activity on behalf of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person who did not have]_

a licence for the carrying out of that activity
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(2) and (4) of the Energy Act 2008.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
caused a person
to carry on an activity within s2(3)
at a controlled place
without a licence for the carrying on of that activity at that place.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
